test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: P, Q, R, S, T and U are six participants of an international Olympiad. Each of them scored different marks on the test. T scored more than Q. S scored more than Q. Q scored more than P and P scored more than R. T scored more than S. R scored more than only one participant. Which participant, among the six, scored the second highest?
solution:
Given: P, Q, R, S, T and U are six participants. 

1) R scored more than only one participant.

__ > __ > __ > __ > R > __

2) Q scored more than P and P scored more than R.

3) T scored more than Q.<
